summary: Rabbi Harari continues analyzing Masekhet Baba Batra regarding communal obligations and tax exemptions for Torah scholars. He explores the story of Rabbi opening his storehouses during a famine, the crown tax in Teveria, and rabbinic opinions on individual versus communal tax burdens. The class concludes with a discussion contrasting the Mishnaic residency requirement for a city dweller with a Beraitah on Ir HaNidahat.
